description: This file defines the LaunchAgentManager enum which manages macOS launch agents by creating, removing, and controlling plist files, and interacting with launchctl to start/stop agents.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent plist exists and if the launchctl print command returns success, indicating the agent is running.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent by writing the plist and running appropriate launchctl commands or removing the plist file.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Writes the launch agent plist file with the specified bundle path.

methods.name: plistContents
methods.description: Generates the XML content of the launch agent plist, embedding paths and environment variables.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Runs launchctl commands asynchronously and returns the process's termination status.
